Name: Garo Sankalp A2-10
Tasting_Notes: Location – Garo Hills, Meghalaya Altitude – 850 - 965 Masl Varietal – Cauvery, SLN 795 Process – Anaerobic Naturals Cup Notes – Java Plum, Black Raisin, Maple Syrup Roast Profile – Light - Medium Net wt.
Desc:
Location – Garo Hills, Meghalaya    Altitude – 850 - 965 Masl    Varietal – Cauvery, SLN 795    Process – Anaerobic Naturals    Cup Notes – Java Plum, Black Raisin, Maple Syrup    Roast Profile – Light - Medium     Net wt. - 250 g | 8.8 oz  
 Garo Sankalp A2-10 represents the evolving journey of  Project Sankalp , an initiative driven by  Waribok Daribok  to push cup quality through structured processing and farmer collaboration. Grown at 850–965 MASL, this lot uses anaerobic natural processing, bringing added depth and intensity to the cup while retaining clarity. Roasted light–medium, it showcases java plum, black raisin, and maple syrup, with a  rich mouthfeel and a layered sweetness  that unfolds as it cools. 
 This release reflects the collective’s continued focus on experimentation, refinement, and raising the bar for coffees from the Garo Hills.

Name: Halli Berri by Kambihalli Estate
Tasting_Notes: Location - Baba Budan Giri, Chikmagalur, Karnataka Altitude – 1200 Masl Varietal – Chandragiri Process – Honey Cup Notes – Lemon Black Tea, Areca Roast Profile – Light - Medium Net wt.
Desc:
Honey processed Chandragiri grown at 1200 MASL in the Bababudan Giri hills of Chikmagalur. Cultivated at   Kambihalli Estate   under shade-grown trees. This coffee reflects a deep connection to land and ecosystem. Expect   lemon black tea notes, mellow sweetness,   and a smooth, well-structured finish.   Kambihalli Estate traces its roots to the Kariappa family’s first land in Kambi‑Halli, or Iron Village. Passed through generations and now led by the women of the family, the estate continues a legacy shaped by care for both people and land. Since 1948, it has cultivated shade‑grown, sustainable specialty coffee in the Bababudan Giri range of the Western Ghats. Pepper, areca, and fruit trees grow alongside the coffee, nurturing biodiversity in a UNESCO‑recognised hotspot. The estate is proudly Rainforest Alliance Certified.  
 
 
   
  Location - Baba Budan Giri, Chikmagalur, Karnataka  
  Altitude – 1200 Masl  
  Varietal – Chandragiri  
  Process – Honey   
  Cup Notes – Lemon Black Tea, Areca  
  Roast Profile – Light - Medium   Net wt. - 250 g | 8.8 oz

  Merthi Subbangudigy Estate (MS Estate) is located in the Sahyadari ranges of the Western Ghats, Chikmagalur, Karnataka. The estate is part of Balanoor Plantations which is run by Mr Ashok Kuriyan and his son Mr Rohan Kuriyan. Arabicas (rain forest certified) are grown under the shade of tress like, Silver Oaks, Dadaps and various jungle woods. Special attention is paid to every aspect of picking, pulping, fermenting, washing, drying and curing. The practice of sustainability and environmental responsibility is the heart of the farm.

Name: Salawara Naturals #01
Tasting_Notes: Location – Belur, Karnataka Altitude – 1080 Masl Varietal – Chandragiri Process – Anaerobic Natural | 75 hours fermented Cup Notes – Cantaloupe, Molasses, Chamomile Roast Profile – Light Medium Net wt.
Desc:
Location – Belur, Karnataka    Altitude – 1080 Masl    Varietal – Chandragiri    Process – Anaerobic Natural | 75 hours fermented    Cup Notes – Cantaloupe, Molasses, Chamomile    Roast Profile – Light Medium     Net wt. - 250 g | 8.8 oz   
 Introducing latest coffee release from  Salawara Estate , located in the lush Western Ghats of India. Established in the late 1880s, this 145-hectare estate has been producing high-quality coffee for generations. 
 Intercropped with pepper, Areca nut, oranges, and silver oak, Salawara’s coffee offers a unique balance of flavours, earning the Best Quality Bean Award from Ernesto Illy in 2018. "Salawara," meaning "a string of blessings," captures the rich tradition and passion behind this  exceptional Indian specialty coffee .

Name: Tripura Hills
Tasting_Notes: Location – Jampui Hills, Tripura Altitude – 800 - 950 Masl Varietal – SLN 5B Process – Traditional Naturals Cup Notes – White Chocolate, Caramel, Toasted Nuts Roast Profile – Light - Medium Net wt.
Desc:
Location – Jampui Hills, Tripura    Altitude – 800 - 950 Masl    Varietal – SLN 5B    Process – Traditional Naturals    Cup Notes – White Chocolate, Caramel, Toasted Nuts    Roast Profile – Light - Medium     Net wt. - 250 g | 8.8 oz  
 Our latest release from Tripura comes from the serene slopes of the Jampui Hills, grown at elevations of 800–950 MASL. This coffee is produced by a  farmer’s collective  working closely with  Waribok Daribok , focusing on consistency, transparency, and flavour-forward processing. 
 A traditional naturals, roasted light–medium at Half Light, Tripura Hills opens up with comforting sweetness and rounded depth. Expect white chocolate, caramel and toasted nuts, making it an  easy-drinking cup with a gentle, lingering finish . This year’s Tripura Hills is all about balance - approachable, expressive, and yet quietly complex.
